approvedBy: Future Light Store owner (explicit Codex authorization)
approvalSource: Future Light Store owner request to keep prices nominal and market-aligned while preserving the approved $16 overhead

scope.products: all active Future Light Store Shopify products and variants
scope.formula: effective live cost plus $16 overhead plus $10 minimum net contribution target, bounded by product market band and psychological rounding; every eligible variant must meet the full cost-plus floor
scope.sourceCostAnomalies: decimal-scale cost fingerprints may be normalized only for the effective price calculation; Shopify unitCost is never mutated
scope.compareAtPrices: preserve absence; when present normalize to at least 1.25x the nominal market sell price with psychological rounding
scope.variantPrices: calculate independently per variant; preserve size, color, bundle, quality, and quantity-tier differences
scope.status: do not change product status, inventory, media, variants, or sales-channel inclusion
